criteria: Engineering regressions; no clinical or device certification

results.name: Near-full quantized 25 Hz sine is usable, without confirmed clipping
Sub-rail limiting produces a warning and remains usable
Clipping and plateau evidence is invariant under callback partitioning
Constant DC is not classified as a limited AC plateau
All-invalid selected intensity does not throw or turn null into zero
Mixed selected intensity retains the finite maximum
HNR excludes unvoiced frames but keeps failed eligible voiced frames in coverage
A single HNR frame stays an explicitly partial estimate
A new calibration with the same numeric offset rejects obsolete verification
Uncertainty never expands the 1 dB drift acceptance limit
Manual and historical preset offsets have no invented 1 kHz provenance
Unsupported Android source falls back once; subsequent recording is usable
Permission errors do not silently trigger a different audio source
Android source fallback preserves noise saving and marks the changed calibration profile
LTAS omits join windows rather than adding artificial high-frequency energy
Segments are analyzed independently before DC removal, resampling and tracking
Formant selection distinguishes input support from persistent tracking context
